{{Short description|Language using characters or symbols}}
In [[mathematics]], a '''symbolic language''' is a language that uses [[Character (computing)|characters]] or [[symbols]] to represent concepts, such as [[Mathematical object|mathematical objects]], [[Operation (mathematics)|operations]], and [[propositions|statements]], and the entities or [[operands]] on which the  operations are performed.<ref name="pc">{{Cite web|url=https://www.pcmag.com/encyclopedia/term/52338/symbolic-language|title=symbolic language Definition from PC Magazine Encyclopedia|website=www.pcmag.com|access-date=2019-03-23}}</ref><ref>{{Cite CiteSeerX|title=A Handbook of Mathematical Discourse|year = 2009|citeseerx = 10.1.1.217.5892}}</ref>
